items.title: Ares Management (ARES) Stock Faces Margin Questions After Q3 Earnings
items.summary: Ares Management came into this Q3 2026 report after a strong run, with the stock up roughly 10.3% over the past month and barely moving on the day of the release, gaining just 0.5%. Investors treated the print as business as usual. The quarter told a sharper story. Revenue landed at US$1.18b and basic earnings per share were US$0.26, while fee related earnings margin held in the low 40% range.
